headline: Supplier outlook constructive; financing concerns and Friday momentum defensive
overall: Price-blind: Microsoft and Meta disclosed elevated capex plans; TSMC and ASML guided strong equipment/leading-edge demand. TrendForce Q4 DRAM/NAND price estimates are not realized data. CoreWeave's reported backlog requires service delivery, and no confirmed chip order cancellations were found. Dated SOXX-wide forward EPS consensus is missing. Independent thesis: AI customer funding constraints could precede semiconductor order revisions; not yet verified. Post-fundamental technical check: Oct 16 SOXX $493.39 (-4.14%), SOXL $93.67 (-12.74%). The repository's Oct 15 DEFENSIVE 3/7 score is stale and not recomputed. No prospective outcome evidence yet for qualitative forecasting effectiveness.

factors.name: AI capex
factors.reason: Facts: Microsoft Jul 29 $41bn quarterly capex; Meta Jul 29 2026 $130-145bn guidance. Expectation: TrendForce Oct 14 projected nine-CSP 2027 capex >$1.5tn, not actual spending. Hypothesis: funding limits some projects. Bull: stronger monetization; bear: reduced budgets. Falsify with guide cuts or continued funded deliveries respectively. Missing: standardized guide baselines and ROI.

factors.name: Semiconductor cycle
factors.assessment: Memory tight; pricing forecast not verified realization (confidence medium)
factors.reason: Fact: Micron Sep 30 Q4 revenue $54.23bn. Expectation: TrendForce Sep 30 forecast Q4 DRAM prices +10-15%, NAND +15-20% QoQ. Hypothesis: server strong, consumer weak. Bull: scarcity; bear: inventory rebuild. Falsify with observed price declines or confirmed sustained scarcity. Missing: realized contract prices, inventories.

factors.name: Earnings revisions
factors.assessment: Strong supplier guidance; SOXX EPS consensus missing (confidence low on revisions)
factors.reason: Facts: TSMC Oct 15 guided Q4 revenue $52.3-54.3bn; ASML Oct 14 reported €11.7bn Q3 sales. Expectations: company guides only. Hypothesis: strength concentrated. Bull: broader EPS raises; bear: cuts despite sales. Falsify with vendor dated constituent EPS revisions. Missing: point-in-time consensus.

factors.name: Competition
factors.reason: Facts: Microsoft Oct 12 described 2027 Maia rollout; Broadcom Sep 2 guided AI semiconductor growth. Expectations: roadmap/company guidance. Hypothesis: ASICs take inference share. Bull: total market expands; bear: GPU margins compress. Falsify via verified adoption/economics. Missing: shares, volumes, costs per token.

factors.name: Macro geopolitics
factors.reason: Facts: BLS Oct 14 CPI 3.7% YoY; Oct 15 PPI 6.3% YoY. No new Oct 18 export policy verified. Hypothesis: high borrowing costs delay marginal deployments. Bull: disinflation; bear: higher cost/export limits. Falsify with improving funding spreads and stable commitments. Missing: borrower terms, enacted policy details.

risks: CoreWeave's Aug 11 disclosed $104bn backlog is conditional on delivery; no verified equipment-order cancellation.
Leveraged SOXL is exposed to path-dependent drawdowns.
Latest repository technical score uses Oct 15 data, not Oct 16.
invalidation: Require primary customer order deferrals before asserting AI hardware demand contraction.
Use realized Q4 memory prices and dated SOXX consensus before scoring forecasts.
Keep forecast baselines/probabilities unchanged; no qualitative skill claim without prospective outcomes.
